data.long_meaning: The name 'Awasim' is derived from the Arabic word 'awasim' which means 'two young camels'. In Islamic history, camels have been a symbol of strength, endurance, and resilience, making this name an excellent choice for a boy in the Islamic community. The name Awasim carries the meaning “Two young camels” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awasim usually hope their child will grow to embody two young camels and live with faith, good character and purpose.
